entries.question: Admissions dayrect nhi hota kya
entries.answer:
Nahi, KGMU mein kisi bhi course mein **direct admission nahi hota hai**. 

KGMU ek premier government medical university hai, aur yahan admission ki prakriya puri tarah se **merit-based** aur **entrance exam-based** hoti hai. Iske mukhya karan ye hain:

1. **Entrance Examination:** KGMU paramedical aur diploma courses (jaise DMLT) ke liye ek nirdharit (fixed) entrance exam karvata hai. Admission ke liye us exam mein qualify karna aur merit list mein naam aana anivarya (compulsory) hai.
2. **Transparency:** University ki admission process poori tarah se transparent hoti hai, jismein seats ka allotment counseling ke madhyam se kiya jata hai.
3. **No Management Quota:** KGMU mein koi management quota ya direct admission ki suvidha nahi hoti hai. Kisi bhi vyakti ya agent dwara direct admission ka dawa karna galat ho sakta hai, isliye aise logon se savdhan rahein.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye?**
* **Notification par nazar rakhein:** Jab admission ke form nikalte hain, toh KGMU ki website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par notice aata hai.
* **Form bharein:** Aapko online form bharna hoga aur entrance exam dena hoga.
* **Counseling:** Exam ke baad merit ke aadhar par counseling hogi, jahan aapko seat allot ki jayegi.

Agar koi aapko "direct admission" dilwane ka wada karta hai, toh kripya us par vishwas na karein, kyunki yeh university ke niyam ke khilaf hai. Sahi jaankari ke liye hamesha official website hi dekhein.
